purpose: Reusable credential custody components; product composition belongs to vPremises
responsibility_boundary: Own the named security/transport mechanism and its explicit trust boundary. Product account/storage/UI composition belongs to the consumer. Tests must not substitute declarations for enforced authority or live environment acceptance.

packages.description: Purpose-specific local composition of Crowsi authorization and credential custody
Public verification contracts for Crowsi credential custody
Account-scoped credential ownership and device-grant authority contracts for Crowsi
Fail-closed local credential references, leases, and metadata-only status contracts
Authenticated one-use credential execution boundary for Crowsi
Finite verified adapter to the central Crowsi credential authority host
Owner-local mnemonic recovery proof provider for Crowsi
Platform custody and public projection for Crowsi PA keys
Bounded WSL-to-Windows DPAPI CurrentUser credential custody
